collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager hangs a string of shells where the breeze can reach them.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) hangs a string of shells where the breeze can reach them. A strong gust sets them clattering, and a nearby pig jumps.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) hangs a string of shells where the breeze can reach them. A child asks to add a shell of their own, and (name1) makes room.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) hangs a string of shells where the breeze can reach them. That night (name1) falls asleep listening to them.

e1__fx.name: Ending 1
e1__fx.text: (name1) hangs a string of shells where the breeze can reach them. They make a gentle clinking sound that (name1) finds soothing.
